children: China fintech firm's Q2 revenue fell 11% yr/yr amid sector funding and regulatory headwinds
Adjusted net income dropped 76% yr/yr as company prioritized asset quality
Company shifted to annual dividend evaluation and repurchased 5.8% of shares under prior program
Company expects Q3 2026 loan origination to decrease significantly quarter-over-quarter
Company says it may incur a net loss in Q3 2026
SECTOR HEADWINDS - Co said sector-wide tightening of funding supply and recent risk events among peers negatively impacted loan volume and market sentiment
LOAN FACILITATION DECLINE - Co attributed drop in credit facilitation service income to decreased APR and origination of off-balance sheet loans
E-COMMERCE PLATFORM GROWTH - Co said installment e-commerce platform service income increased due to higher transaction volume
Q2 Adjusted Net Income per ADS
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the consumer lending peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. is $3.00, about 154.2% above its August 28 closing price of $1.18
The stock recently traded at 1 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 2 three months ago
